summary: Emit drain only after a Writable that returned false becomes ready for more writes.

target.notes: Register through EventEmitter semantics; runtime emits drain when previously backpressured queued data has drained enough that writing should resume.

caveats: drain is not emitted for every completed write.
The exact scheduling depends on the writable implementation and remains runtime-managed.

tests.name: drain follows backpressure
tests.expected_behavior: prints drain after the buffered write advances

tests.name: no required drain after true write
tests.expected_behavior: prints true; caller must not wait for drain
